title: Phase 10 Final Release Architecture and Retrospective

segments.text: Rahul Verma: We have reached Phase 10 release readiness. The multi-agent organizational reasoning engine has passed all evaluation benchmarks with zero hallucination on unestablished facts.
Priya Sharma: PostgreSQL with pgvector is handling hybrid vector and relational queries with under 15ms latency across all historical organizational memory.
Kiran Das: The Kubernetes cluster deployment and automated scaling policies are active. All unit and integration test suites pass completely.
Nisha Patel: The Google Meet connector is operational. Nisha Patel completed the Google Meet connector implementation on September 18th ahead of schedule.
